---
title: Neapolitan Crostini
id: MAR-0029
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of country bread
- 9 anchovy fillets
- 2 mozzarella
- 2 tomatoes
- 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste oregano,
- to taste salt,
## Method
1. Cut the mozzarella into small cubes and the anchovy fillets into pieces.
2. Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half, remove the seed water, and cut them into cubes.
3. Cut the bread slices in half, brush with oil, and top with the anchovy pieces, mozzarella cubes, and tomato cubes; season with oil and a little salt, then sprinkle with oregano.
4. Place the crostini on the oven tray lined with parchment paper, and bake at 200 °C for about 5 minutes.
